tagline.en_US: Syncs watch history, ratings and watchlists between Plex, Jellyfin, Emby and trackers such as Trakt and SIMKL.

description.en_US: CrossWatch tracks viewing activity and synchronizes watchlists, ratings, history, playback progress, and collections across media servers and tracking services. It supports server-to-server, server-to-tracker, and tracker-to-tracker syncing with customizable routes and schedules. The application includes tools to review changes interactively, fix incorrect metadata matches, and maintain a local snapshot archive.

tips: Connect the accounts you want to use as your first step.
Create a sync pair by choosing which services to connect and what to sync.
Use Interactive Sync if you want to review additions, updates, and removals before applying them.
